cards.name: Char's Z'Gok
cards.effect:
【During Pair】While 2 or more other friendly (Marine) Units are in play, enemy Units can't choose this Unit as their attack target.
【Deploy】If another friendly (Marine) Unit is in play, choose 1 enemy Unit that is Lv.2 or lower. Return it to the bottom of its owner's deck.

faqs.q: If I return a Unit with a paired Pilot to the bottom of its owner's deck with this 【Deploy】 effect, which player determines the order to return them in?
faqs.a: The owner of the cards being returned determines the order and returns them to the bottom of the deck.

cards.name: Zock
cards.effect:
While another friendly (Marine) Unit is in play, this Unit gains <Blocker>.
(Rest this Unit to change the attack target to it.)

faqs.q: With the conditions for its effect fulfilled, this Unit gains <Blocker> and blocks an enemy Unit. After that, the conditions become unfulfilled and it loses <Blocker>. At this time, what happens to this Unit's block?
faqs.a: Since the block is already established, the two Units continue their battle.
